content2.content: Publishing involves uploading your build and providing store listing details.

content4.content: Create a developer account, create an app in the Play Console, upload your AAB, and complete the store listing (screenshots, description).

content6.content: Enroll in the Apple Developer Program, create an app record in App Store Connect, upload your build via Xcode or Transporter, and submit for review.

content8.content: The review process can take time (especially for Apple), so plan accordingly.
